name: components-community-notification-list

frames.best_why: All three rows are fully fanned out and the footer shows the settled View all label, with no cursor over the cards.

tagline: Stacked alert cards fan apart when the panel is hovered.
summary: A small dark panel holds three notification rows stacked on top of each other; hovering spreads them into a readable list and swaps the footer label to View all.
appearance: A rounded charcoal panel on a black stage contains three rounded rows, each with a title, a right-aligned repeat count, and a grey line of time and subtitle. Collapsed, the rows overlap into one stack; a grey circle with 3 sits beside the footer label.
behaviour: On hover the rows spring apart to full width while the footer text fades from Notifications to View all; leaving collapses them back into a tight stack.
demo_content: NPM Install Complete, Build Succeeded and Lint Passed, with times 1m 11s and 5m and package counts.
search_phrases: stacked notification cards that fan out
list of recent alerts with timestamps
cards overlap then spread on hover
notification stack with view all link
app activity feed in a small panel
use_when: A compact corner widget should show a few recent alerts and expand in place on hover.
avoid_when: Hover-only opening hides the full list from touch and keyboard users, and three rows is a small ceiling.
customise: The three alerts are written inside the component, so titles, times and counts need a file edit; the width, spring and hover trigger are fixed in source too.
weight_why: Three small cards and one spring; nothing runs until hover.

a11y.note: The panel is not focusable, so expansion is hover-only and unreachable by keyboard or touch; View all is a plain span.

issues: View all is a styled span, not a link, so it cannot be clicked or reached by tab.
Every row uses an h1, so the panel produces three top-level headings.
polish_why: Clean stacking and a tactile spring; hover-only reveal and the dead View all hold it back.
